name: NVIDIA FY2022-FY2026 经营质量分析工作流
description: 年度与季度结构化数据、年报资料和官方网页共同形成可复核的五年经营分析及多格式成果。

nodes.name: 获取五年财务指标 API

config.taskName: 获取 NVIDIA 五年财务指标

config.sql: SELECT fiscal_quarter, revenue_usd_m, data_center_revenue_usd_m, gross_margin_pct, operating_income_usd_m, operating_cash_flow_usd_m, inventory_usd_m, source_note FROM demo_examples.nvidia_quarterly_operating_metrics ORDER BY fiscal_quarter
config.taskName: 读取 NVIDIA 季度经营指标

nodes.name: 计算五年经营质量指标

config.requirements: 统一财年和百万美元口径，交叉核对 API 与 CSV，确定性计算增长、利润率、现金转化、研发投入率、库存增速和数据中心占比。
config.script: SELECT a.fiscal_year, a.revenue_usd_m, a.gross_profit_usd_m, a.operating_income_usd_m, a.net_income_usd_m, a.operating_cash_flow_usd_m, a.rd_expense_usd_m, a.inventory_usd_m, a.data_center_revenue_usd_m, a.gross_margin_pct, ROUND(a.net_income_usd_m/NULLIF(a.revenue_usd_m,0)*100,2) AS net_margin_pct, ROUND(a.operating_cash_flow_usd_m/NULLIF(a.net_income_usd_m,0)*100,2) AS cash_conversion_pct, ROUND(a.rd_expense_usd_m/NULLIF(a.revenue_usd_m,0)*100,2) AS rd_ratio_pct, ROUND(a.data_center_revenue_usd_m/NULLIF(a.revenue_usd_m,0)*100,2) AS data_center_mix_pct, ROUND((a.revenue_usd_m/LAG(a.revenue_usd_m) OVER(ORDER BY a.fiscal_year)-1)*100,2) AS revenue_yoy_pct, ROUND((a.inventory_usd_m/LAG(a.inventory_usd_m) OVER(ORDER BY a.fiscal_year)-1)*100,2) AS inventory_yoy_pct FROM annual a ORDER BY a.fiscal_year

nodes.name: 分析季度动能与风险信号

config.requirements: 计算 FY2025-FY2026 季度收入增速、数据中心占比、现金转化及库存压力，并保留来源说明。
config.script: SELECT fiscal_quarter, revenue_usd_m, data_center_revenue_usd_m, gross_margin_pct, operating_income_usd_m, operating_cash_flow_usd_m, inventory_usd_m, ROUND((revenue_usd_m/LAG(revenue_usd_m) OVER(ORDER BY fiscal_quarter)-1)*100,2) AS sequential_revenue_growth_pct, ROUND(data_center_revenue_usd_m/NULLIF(revenue_usd_m,0)*100,2) AS data_center_mix_pct, ROUND(operating_cash_flow_usd_m/NULLIF(operating_income_usd_m,0)*100,2) AS cash_to_operating_income_pct, source_note FROM quarterly ORDER BY fiscal_quarter

config.query: NVIDIA FY2022 FY2023 FY2024 FY2025 FY2026 revenue margin cash flow R&D inventory data center customer concentration export controls supply chain

nodes.name: AI 五年经营综合分析

config.prompt: 你是严谨的上市公司经营分析负责人。综合五年经营质量指标、季度动能、业务结构、风险监测表、年报摘要、风险备忘录、官方年报、SEC 10-K 与 XBRL。逐项解释收入、利润、现金流、研发、库存和数据中心结构变化；识别 FY2023 周期低点与 FY2024-FY2026 增长阶段；分析产品过渡、客户集中、出口管制和供应链风险。所有金额沿用上游百万美元口径，不编造数字。区分公开事实、可复算指标、演示数据和判断，并为每条核心观点保留 Ref。
